description: The Operational Land Imager (OLI) on Landsat 8, a nine-band pushbroom imager (coastal aerosol to SWIR, plus panchromatic and cirrus bands). The curves are the in-band band-average relative spectral responses from the USGS RSR workbook.
facility_description: Landsat is the joint NASA/USGS series of Earth-observing satellites (Landsat 1-9, since 1972); USGS operates the missions and distributes the data.

notes: Band names follow SVO's Landsat/OLI IDs (Coastal, Blue, Green, Red, NIR, SWIR1, SWIR2, Pan, Cirrus = OLI bands 1-9); SVO's records cite the NASA 'preliminary' OLI RSR page and agree with these curves to <0.1 % in pivot. DetectorType energy is assumed.
